The running max has been frozen at 82.4°F for seven straight hours (since 13:00 ET), the current temperature is 5.4°F below that peak and falling, and at 20:00 ET there is no realistic atmospheric mechanism to regenerate enough surface heating to challenge the afternoon maximum.
